description: During Plaud ingest, read stale staged markdown files instead of re-fetching from the Plaud API first. Reported 'Andrew (PE Analyst)' as an unidentified speaker when David had already tagged him as Andrew Neuberger in Plaud. The skill requires a fresh fetch before reading staged files.
correction: Should have run fetch_plaud.py before reading staged .md files to pull the latest speaker tags and transcript data from the API.
systemic_fix: Add explicit fetch-first gate to Plaud ingest execution: always run fetch_plaud.py before reading any staged .md content. Staged files are not authoritative — the API is.
